items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: But fortunately he was able to sell the whole thing to Norman Granz.

ctx.x: But there was a very sensible reason for it stopping. It became a real chore for Howie Richmond because he was not a record man to begin with. He was an extremely successful businessman, but he ran into an obstacle that he had never really heard of before, and that was independent distributors, where you send out the records and make the investment and then never get your money back.
And so, he was devoting more time to trying to get the monies than -- it just wasn't worth the bother. But fortunately he was able to sell the whole thing to Norman Granz.
